Name: Crusty Valley for Content Patcher
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
Does your SDV farm look too clean? Then get Crusty Valley and make it a little more realistic and grimy!
Crusty Valley adds:
- Moss to most farm buildings!
- Rust to your starter tools!
- A rustier rusty sword!
- A dilapidated first farmhouse!
- A slightly better second farmhouse!
- A pristine and clean third farmhouse!


[b]How to install:

[/b]1. Install [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]!
2. Drag [CP] Crusty Valley to your Mods folder!
3. Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿!
4. Open SDV and enjoy a more [i]crusty[/i] world!



[b][u]Planned for future updates:
[/u][/b]- Crustiness added to town buildings and landmarks!
- Foliage crustified!
- Crusty furniture edits?

Downloads.Description: Download this and place it in your Mods folder.
